about: Brands and models the lookup knows. Every fact names its source: a URL, or "owner" for the project owner's own statements and decisions. A brand name with "search": true is used in search queries; every name is accepted when matching result titles. A name with "onlyFor" applies only to models of that category. A model's "year" holds the first and, optionally, the last year it was made or sold.
